params.name: parameters
params.description: Graph and spline kinds only: { parameterName: value } overrides; each value a string, number, boolean or null, parsed as the parameter's type, and null sets an object parameter to None.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the content packages this call dirties before replying; default true. Levels are never saved.

params.name: actorPath
params.description: Stamp actor object path; preferred, since stamp actors relabel themselves.

params.name: actorLabel
params.description: Stamp actor label; must match exactly one actor.

params.name: componentName
params.description: UVoxelStampComponent object name; default the actor's first one.

params.name: values
params.description: Non-empty { parameterName: value } overrides on the stamp's height or volume graph; each value a string, number, boolean or null, parsed as the parameter's type, and null sets an object parameter to None.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the content packages this call dirties before replying; default true. Levels are never saved.

params.name: assetPath
params.description: UVoxelSurfaceTypeAsset asset path.

params.name: material
params.description: UMaterialInterface asset path (material or instance); "" or null clears it.

params.name: invisible
params.description: Render nothing, to cut holes in the terrain; default false.

params.name: blendSmoothness
params.description: Smooth blend amount, >= 0 (ClampMin); the details panel offers 0 to 1. Default 0.5.

params.name: seed
params.description: Text for the surface's exposed seed; a number is written as its text.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the asset's package after the edit; default true.

params.name: actorPath
params.description: AVoxelSculptVolume actor object path; preferred, since voxel actors relabel themselves.

params.name: actorLabel
params.description: AVoxelSculptVolume actor label; must match exactly one actor.

params.name: op
params.description: The edit; each op takes only its own fields.

params.name: center
params.description: Required except for clear_data and clear_cache: the edit center in world centimetres.

params.name: radius
params.description: Every op but cube: radius in world centimetres, > 0; default 1000 for sphere and smooth, 500 otherwise.

params.name: strength
params.description: smooth (default 1), surface (default 0.5), angle (default 1) or paint (default 0.05) strength, >= 0.

params.name: mode
params.description: sphere, cube, surface and paint: EVoxelSculptMode; default Add.

params.name: smoothness
params.description: sphere and cube: add/remove smoothness, >= 0; default 0.

params.name: size
params.description: cube: size in centimetres, each component > 0; default 1000 on every axis.

params.name: rotation
params.description: cube and apply_graph: rotation in degrees; default zero.

params.name: roundness
params.description: cube: corner roundness 0..1; default 0.

params.name: normal
params.description: flatten: plane normal, non-zero; default up {0,0,1}.

params.name: height
params.description: flatten: distance up and down to sculpt in centimetres, >= 0; default 1000.

params.name: falloff
params.description: 0..1. flatten: the flatten falloff, default 0.1. smooth, surface, angle, paint: the brush falloff unless brush.falloffAmount is set.

params.name: levelType
params.description: flatten EVoxelLevelToolType; default Additive.

params.name: planePoint
params.description: angle: a point on the target plane in world centimetres; default center.

params.name: planeNormal
params.description: angle: target plane normal, non-zero; default up {0,0,1}.

params.name: mergeMode
params.description: angle: EVoxelSDFMergeMode; default Override.

params.name: surfaceType
params.description: paint: UVoxelSurfaceTypeInterface asset path to paint; paint needs this and/or metadata.

params.name: metadata
params.description: paint: { UVoxelMetadata asset path: value } to paint; each value a string, number or boolean, parsed as the metadata's type.

params.name: graph
params.description: apply_graph, required: UVoxelVolumeSculptGraph asset path.

params.name: parameters
params.description: apply_graph: { parameterName: value } overrides on the sculpt graph; each value a string, number or boolean, parsed as the parameter's type.

params.name: brush
params.description: smooth, surface, angle, paint: the brush; type picks its fields. Default a Circular brush.

variants.description: A round brush shaped by its falloff.

fields.name: falloffAmount
fields.description: Brush falloff 0..1; default 0.5. Pass this or the top-level falloff, not both.

fields.name: hitNormal
fields.description: Surface normal the brush aligns to, non-zero; default up {0,0,1}.

variants.description: A texture mask stamped along the stroke.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: UVoxelTexture asset path sampled as the brush mask.

fields.name: autoRotate
fields.description: Rotate the mask along the stroke; default true.

fields.name: use2DProjection
fields.description: Project the mask in 2D; default false.

fields.name: falloffAmount
fields.description: Brush falloff 0..1; default 0.5. Pass this or the top-level falloff, not both.

fields.name: hitNormal
fields.description: Surface normal the brush aligns to, non-zero; default up {0,0,1}.

variants.description: A texture tiled in world space.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: UVoxelTexture asset path sampled as the brush mask.

fields.name: centerTextureOnOrigin
fields.description: Center the pattern on origin; default false.

fields.name: repeatSize
fields.description: World size of one pattern repeat in centimetres, > 0; default 1000.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Pattern origin {x,y} in world centimetres; default {0,0}.

fields.name: falloffAmount
fields.description: Brush falloff 0..1; default 0.5. Pass this or the top-level falloff, not both.

fields.name: hitNormal
fields.description: Surface normal the brush aligns to, non-zero; default up {0,0,1}.

params.name: wait
params.description: Wait for the edit to finish; default true. false returns queued: true, and the queued edit is covered by neither undo nor the auto-save.

params.name: save
params.description: Save the content packages this call dirties before replying; default true. Levels are never saved.

params.name: actorPath
params.description: AVoxelWorld actor object path; preferred, since labels can repeat.

params.name: actorLabel
params.description: AVoxelWorld actor label; must match exactly one actor.

params.name: layerStack
params.description: UVoxelLayerStack asset path; "" or null clears it.

params.name: megaMaterial
params.description: UVoxelMegaMaterial asset path; "" or null clears it.

params.name: voxelSize
params.description: Voxel size in centimetres, an integer >= 1; the default world uses 100.

params.name: lodQuality
params.description: FVoxelLODQuality merged onto the current value; each interval needs 0 < min <= max after the merge.

fields.name: min
fields.description: Lowest quality, > 0; default keeps the current value.

fields.name: max
fields.description: Highest quality, >= min; default keeps the current value.

fields.name: min
fields.description: Lowest quality, > 0; default keeps the current value.

fields.name: max
fields.description: Highest quality, >= min; default keeps the current value.

fields.name: alwaysUseGameQuality
fields.description: Use gameQuality in the editor too.

params.name: qualityExponent
params.description: LOD selection bias; higher gives far chunks more resolution. The details panel offers 0.5 to 1.5; default 1.

params.name: enableNanite
params.description: Render the voxel mesh with Nanite; default true.

params.name: enableTessellation
params.description: Nanite tessellation (displacement); default true.

params.name: enableLumen
params.description: Include the voxel mesh in Lumen; default false.

params.name: enableRaytracing
params.description: Visible in ray-traced effects; default false.

params.name: generateMeshDistanceFields
params.description: Generate mesh distance fields; default false.

params.name: blockinessMetadata
params.description: UVoxelFloatMetadata asset path selecting how blocky each voxel renders; "" or null clears it.

params.name: renderChunkSize
params.description: EVoxelRenderChunkSize render chunk size in voxels; default Size32.

params.name: useCameraAsInvoker
params.description: Use the camera as an LOD invoker; default true.

params.name: createRuntimeOnBeginPlay
params.description: Create the runtime on BeginPlay; false needs a manual CreateRuntime. Default true.

params.name: waitOnBeginPlay
params.description: Block BeginPlay until the world is generated; default true.

params.name: limitMaxLOD
params.description: Enable the maxLOD render cap; default false.

params.name: maxLOD
params.description: With limitMaxLOD, chunks with a LOD strictly above this are not rendered; an int32, default 30.

params.name: maxBackgroundTasks
params.description: Background task cap, an integer >= 1; default 256.

params.name: doubleSidedCollision
params.description: Double-sided collision; default false.

params.name: generateOverlapEvents
params.description: Collision generates overlap events; default false.

params.name: collisionChunkSize
params.description: Invoker collision chunk size in voxels, an integer >= 1; default 32.

params.name: overrideCollisionVoxelSize
params.description: Use collisionVoxelSize instead of voxelSize for collision; default false.

params.name: collisionVoxelSize
params.description: Collision voxel size in centimetres, an integer >= 1; default 100.

params.name: enableNavigation
params.description: Generate navigation on voxel chunks; default true.

params.name: navigationChunkSize
params.description: Navigation chunk size in voxels, an integer >= 1; default 32.

params.name: generateNavigationInsideNavMeshBounds
params.description: Generate navigation on every chunk inside NavMeshBoundsVolumes, expensive for large bounds; default false.

params.name: onlyGenerateNavigationInEditor
params.description: Only generate navigation in the editor, for baking; default false.

params.name: overrideNavigationVoxelSize
params.description: Use navigationVoxelSize instead of voxelSize for navigation; default false.

params.name: navigationVoxelSize
params.description: Navigation voxel size in centimetres, an integer >= 1; default 100.

params.name: renderScatterActors
params.description: Render scatter actors; default true.
